evidence.observation: Tube pressure drifts monotonically upward during growth, 3.01→3.36 Torr from k=22 to k=25, while setpoints are constant
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not from a flow change
Thermocouple holds 750 °C with plausible heater power (~44-45%), so thermal control looks normal
Exhaust O2 sensor not installed, so air ingress cannot be checked directly

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading (or a pump-down/flow-step test: halt Ar and watch pressure — continued rise implies a leak, immediate fall implies a downstream restriction) to distinguish seal leak from exhaust blockage; also post-run characterization of the film.
